# hallpass_operator_chat_link (Resource)

Links a Slack or Telegram account to an operator, so approvals from that account in chat act as the operator (within the operator's approver rules). **Whoever controls the chat account approves as the operator**, so take the user ID from the chat provider, not from a message. HallPass removes an operator's chat links when the operator is disabled or their password is set or changed; the next apply links the account again. Destroying it unlinks the account. Import with `<operator_id>/<platform>/<workspace>/<provider_user_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Ada approves from Telegram: her numeric Telegram user ID, and the bot's workspace identifier as the console shows it.
resource "hallpass_operator_chat_link" "ada_telegram" {
  operator_id      = hallpass_operator.ada.id
  platform         = "telegram"
  workspace        = "7012345678"
  provider_user_id = "123456789"
  display          = "@ada"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `operator_id` (String) Operator ID (`opr_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `platform` (String) `slack` or `telegram`. Changing it forces a new link.
- `provider_user_id` (String) The chat account's user ID (Slack member ID, Telegram numeric user ID). Changing it forces a new link.
- `workspace` (String) Slack team ID, or the Telegram integration's workspace identifier, as the console shows it. Changing it forces a new link.

### Optional

- `display` (String) Label shown in the console, for example `@alice`. Changing it forces a new link.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<operator_id>/<platform>/<workspace>/<provider_user_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <operator_id>/<platform>/<workspace>/<provider_user_id>
terraform import hallpass_operator_chat_link.ada_telegram opr_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j/telegram/7012345678/123456789
```
